out_of_schema_notes: Classification is a result of the study, so every parameter_type is 'unclassified'. No set-point or NOR of the step changed at Version 2.0, so ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the values of the parameter table, which are also the values in force. ProcessParameter.PAR carries the range studied, as everywhere in the corpus; the plan claims no proven acceptable range and no design space (it says so: ExplicitNonClaim records), so there are no ProvenAcceptableRange or DesignSpace records. Each parameter is anchored on its row of the parameter table and on its sentence of the factors section; post-clarification turbidity is a parameter as the plan lists it, measured, not set, in the other two series (the note of the table, also an ExplicitNonClaim).

The step forms no quality attribute. The QualityAttribute records are the four attributes of the attribute table; their acceptance_criteria are the drug substance criteria printed there, which the plan states are not in-process limits for the clarified harvest (an ExplicitNonClaim). Fragments are assigned to the step by the CQA register but are not a response of the study.

acceptance_criteria: the plan prints no criteria-change table, because PCMP-001 Table 7.1 sets no intermediate acceptance criterion for the clarified harvest and Version 1.0 applied no analysis-time criterion at the step. The records are the decision criteria of Version 1.0, kept in Version 2.0 and in force: criterion 1 (impurity release) for host cell protein and residual DNA and criterion 3 (product quality) for the high molecular weight content are comparisons within a run, so low, high and unit are empty and the basis states the rule; criterion 2 (clarification) is the absolute limit on post-clarification turbidity (attribute 'turbidity', the parameter key). Step yield is reported and not gated (an ExplicitNonClaim).

studies holds the univariate study S-HAR-UNI, anchored on the sentence of the schedule that gives its execution window, on its design sentences, on the rows of the planned levels (Appendix A) that occur once in the document (the continuation rows of the depth filter load series read alike in the blocks of its two centrates) and on the rows of the sampling schedule (Appendix B). Neither StudyDesign carries n_runs or n_center_points: Version 1.0 set no number of set-point replicates, and the qualification compares scale-down runs with manufacturing-scale batches. The qualification of the scale-down model has no study id in the plan or in the study chronology, so its StudyDesign keeps the Version 1.0 concept id study:hv_sdm_qual and has no execution window; its responses are the outputs as the plan names them. Studies of the step made after Version 1.0 are not studies of this plan, and the plan does not mention them; PCR-004 records them as discrepancies from it: S-HAR-UNI2 (PD-004-01); S-HAR-HLD (PD-004-02).

Each AnalyticalMethod record is anchored on its sentence of the analytical methods section (nrCE-SDS on the change that adds it), on its row of the procedures table and, for the three methods with validation data, on its row of the performance table. Turbidity by nephelometry (AMV-3015) measures post-clarification turbidity, a parameter, so that record has no associated attribute and no attribute_measured_by_method assertion.

Equipment: the three units of the commercial train are at the receiving site, anchored on their sentences and on the roles-table row of the receiving site, which confirms the commercial operation; the scale-down model and its three parts (bench shear device, laboratory centrifuge, disks of the commercial filter media) are at the sending site, as the other plans place a scale-down model. The scale-down Protein A column of the load challenge is an Equipment record with no step_uses_equipment assertion: it is not equipment of the harvest step, and the plan does not identify it with the column of the Protein A plan.

parameter_impacts_attribute assertions are the plan's stated expectations from the mechanism of the step, not results. attribute_has_acceptance_criterion assertions carry criterion 1 for host cell protein and residual DNA and criterion 3 for aggregate.

Each correction of change 7 is a statement anchored on the Version 1.0 sentence, the correction and the corrected sentence where it stands (marked "(corrected, change 7)" in the document). Each row of the roles, performance, attribute, parameter and sampling tables is a statement. The approvals table and the abbreviations are not represented. No rhetorical_spans: a plan has none. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 4 of the A-Mab drug substance process. Harvest separates the antibody from the cells and the cell debris of the production culture: once per batch the contents of the 15,000 L production bioreactor pass a continuous disk-stack centrifuge, a train of positively charged depth filters and a sterilizing-grade filter, and the clarified harvest is held in the harvest vessel until Protein A capture. The step determines the quality of the feed to capture. The centrifuge and the filters are not expected to change a quality attribute of the antibody, but cell breakage can release host cell protein and DNA, and fragments continue to form in the clarified harvest. The step is not credited with clearing host cell protein, DNA or aggregate, and no viral clearance is claimed for it.
input_materials: contents of the production bioreactor at the end of culture
output_materials: clarified harvest, held in the harvest vessel until Protein A capture
equipment: scale-down model of the commercial harvest train
